name: Yeh Li
bio: Yeh Li is dated by Giles to the 13th century AD. His poem here is a scholar’s spring among his books.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: At His Books
poems.author: Yeh Li
poems.text:
Shadows of pairing sparrows cross his book,
Of poplar catkins, dropping overhead
The weary student from his window-nook
Looks up to find that spring is long since dead.
